notes.title: New Froggin’ Awesome Trading Cards!
notes.content:
If you’ve been playing Valley Peaks you’ve probably encountered several items you can collect - juice boxes, mushrooms, bones 👀 

But now we bring you one more item to collect - [b]Trading Cards![/b]

[h2]MAIL TIME![/h2]

Ahead of the Valley Peaks release we commissioned several artists to create postcards for Valley Peaks in each of their own unique styles. We loved them so much we’ve decided to use them for our Trading Cards! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43300267/91904acfe7a441122a8ea9f04452f3acc72494cc.png[/img]

There are a total of 15 custom cards to collect. The cards will randomly be dropped in your inventory as you play the game. The more you play - the more cards you’ll collect. You can even trade with your friends! 

We’re also adding some new profile backgrounds and emoticons, so you can make your Steam Account look froggy fresh!

[h2]A new frog joins us in the Valley Peaks[/h2]

You might remember [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2107550/view/4366886392540454265?l=english]our froggy contest[/url] from a while back before launch, where a ton of you submitted your amazing custom frogs. We finally added the winner, [url=https://x.com/AtlasErisVT/status/1814345606179250238][b]AtlasErisVT's Prince[/b][/url], into Valley Peaks, so make sure you drop by and say hi to them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43300267/5dc79cc86df5062f1e66bd70c039bc1d576e01ab.jpg[/img]

As always thank you to our incredible community - we are thrilled to see so many of you enjoying our game. Please tell your friends about us and encourage them to take the climb! And if you haven’t left a review already please consider leaving one 🐸👉👈 It helps us out SO much - plus we love reading them 😅

That’s about it for now! Keep on climbin’ and collect those [b]Trading Cards[/b]!

🐸💖

notes.title: Cozy Frogs, Biking Frogs, and Chatty Frogs!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's been a while since our last update. The team has been working tirelessly to make Valley Peaks the best game possible, and we can't wait to show you what we've been up to!

[h1]New Features:[/h1]

[list]
[*] We want Valley Peaks to be accessible to as many gamers as possible. This includes a new mode that will help with the difficulty of climbing for players who want to relax. For a cozy climbing adventure select the Wholesome Mode when you boot up the game. And for a more challenging climbing experience select Normal Mode.
[*] We’ve added a new main story line about the player and their father. Discover memories and uncover lost photos to see how the story unfolds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43300267/d3026d769ab2088618d7e7fae211f52821a51a91.gif[/img]
[*] More life has been given to our frogs! You can now spot them cycling, riding motorbikes and riding tractors! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43300267/c96bf6ddfe93775f1ee961f444954f3809206712.gif[/img]
[*] Our new multi-dialogue frogs sure do have a lot to say! We’re working to add more depth and richness to your interactions with the froggys by giving them more to talk about. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43300267/edb4c5d4f5cc37c2f5b2204a6bf1814ba27a7a2d.gif[/img]
[/list]

In addition to these new features we’ve been working on bug fixes based on your feedback. We’ve also been refining the visuals, ensuring that every corner of Valley Peaks is more beautiful and immersive than ever. 

Thank you to all our testers and everyone who has played our demo! Your feedback is invaluable and has been instrumental in making Valley Peaks the best it can be!

[b]Stay tuned for the big reveal of our official launch date.[/b] We’re closer than ever to sharing Valley Peaks with the world!

For exclusive previews and behind-the-scenes looks at the development process follow us on social media: [url=https://x.com/valleypeaksgame]@valleypeaksgame[/url] on formerly recognized bird app. We couldn't have made it this far without your support and enthusiasm.

We’re excited for the journey ahead and can’t wait for you to experience all that Valley Peaks has to offer.

Hoppily,
The Valley Peaks Team 🐸

notes.title: Valley Peaks + Glasgow Children's Hospital Charity Fundraiser!
notes.content:
Howdy, fellow mountaineers! We've got some exciting news to share that will warm your heart! 
Valley Peaks is teaming up with Glasgow Children's Hospital Charity for a fundraising event, sponsored by our pals at Nerial, to kickstart the Scottish Games Sale on Steam! We're proud to join in with other great Scottish studios showcasing their games in the Daily Deal. 

Mark your calendars for Thursday, September 7th, between 6:30 PM - 10:00 PM!

💖 Support a Worthy Cause

The best part? It's all for a good cause! By joining us, you'll be helping the Glasgow Children's Hospital Charity make a positive impact on the lives of young ones in need: funds raised will go towards consoles, adapted equipment, and even a hospital 'gamer in residence' plus gaming volunteers! 
What's better than gaming for a cause, right?

🎮 Online or Onsite - Take Your Pick!

If you're in Glasgow, we've got a special treat for you! Join us at Barclays Eagle Labs at the Beco Building, 58 Kingston Street for an evening together with many guests and games, and maybe even a few doughnuts to keep your energy levels up. Yes, you heard that right – DOUGHNUTS! 🍩

But wait, there's more! For those of you who can't make it to Glasgow, fret not! An equally awesome online event will take place during the foundraiser, packed with Scottish streamers and gaming personalities, all rallying for a fantastic cause!

A massive thank you to each and every one of you who've supported Valley Peaks along the way. Your passion for adventure and gaming is what keeps us climbing those virtual peaks day after day. Let's continue this journey together and make a real-world impact!

See you on September 7th, and remember, there will be doughnuts! 🍩🎮 #ValleyPeaksCharityEven
